Name: Children Inherit Colors
Author: agent56
Description:
This mod uses my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15655]Genetics API[/url] mod to give the vanilla children randomized appearances.
Also uses the sprites from my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15544]Shadow Babies[/url] mod for funsies. (Can be disabled by setting "KrobusMonsterBabies" to "false" in the config.json)

[size=4]Versions
[/size][size=3][u]
Vanilla
[/u][/size]Simply provides recolored vanilla sprites to display the unique colors that Genetics API generates

[u][size=3]Less Vanilla
[/size][/u]Changes female toddler hairstyle and adds two new ones for the 'Alt' functionality of GeneticsAPI to provide more diverse children

Gives the toddlers outfits that load off of hair and eye color, then changes to vanilla pjs past 8pm

Manifest.Name: Children Inherit Colors
Manifest.Description: Changes the baby and toddler sprites to use Genetics API in order to inherit colors from their parents.
Manifest.Author: Agent56

Manifest.Name: Children Inherit Colors - Less Vanilla
Manifest.Description: Changes the baby and toddler sprites to use Genetics API in order to inherit colors from their parents.
